answer: A scripted farm therefore has to pad 74 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is recorded against the willow challenge, the vertex audit can replay the ember history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 3629 identities would post 2224 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
